items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jason was born in… He’s 45 so he was born in ‘56, I guess.

ctx.x: Jason was born in… He’s 45 so he was born in ‘56, I guess. She had the three boys in ’57 without me. That extensive tour was really… she believed in this music so much that she just gave me to the world. That lady you just met, June, when I see the in 40th anniversary compilation, that box set, and June Heath is not mentioned, it galls me because before Mrs. Lewis and Mrs. Jackson were even on the scene, Mrs. Heath was behind all of that.
